title: StarNest: Open-Source Web Pipeline for Open Star Cluster Photometry and Kinematics
description: StarNest takes a Gaia DR3 cone-search catalogue of an open cluster and returns Gaussian-mixture membership, extinction, a PARSEC isochrone fit, proper-motion and 3-D kinematics, a mass function compared with Salpeter, Kroupa and Chabrier, binary-aware stellar and cluster masses, and mass-segregation and tidal diagnostics. It runs as a web app, as Python modules and as a batch command line. The mass method is inspired by Almeida, Monteiro & Dias (2023, MNRAS 525, 2315) but is not a strict replication; see the repository README, section 9.
